payload.title: File:Tropidosuchus romeri frontals.jpg
payload.artist_html: Claudio A. Mamani, M. Jimena Trotteyn, Fernando E. Novas, Julia B. Desojo and Martín D. Ezcurra
payload.description_html: Digital reconstruction of the right and left frontal of Tropidosuchus romeri (PVL 4604) in (a) right lateral view; (b) left lateral view; (c) dorsal view; (d) ventral view; (e) anterior view; and (f) posterior view. anp, anterior process; md, medial depression; mls, midline suture; olt, olfactory tract; or, orbital rim. Scale bars equal 5 mm.
